moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Posts and comments hidden by three reports or by a moderator, in your city. Restore what is fine; delete what breaks the rules, with a reason the author will understand.
moderation.deleteBody: It disappears for everyone. The reason is kept in the audit log.
moderation.reasonHint: At least 3 characters, e.g. "Shares a phone number".
moderation.failed: That didn't go through. The item is back in the queue; try again.
moderation.emptyHint: Posts and comments that collect three reports appear here.
